_about: Flat textures for things in the world (Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_ui_art.py surfaces, no style: the prompt says it all), keyed by what they cover. AgentScripts/BuildUIArt.cs (Surfaces) puts each on its material. Each fills its frame edge to edge, seen straight on, with no background, folds or shadows, as it is wrapped on a flat face.

banner_cloth.prompt: Flat textile texture seen straight on and filling the whole frame edge to edge: a hand-woven deep forest-green wool banner cloth with a large golden embroidered emblem in the centre, a tree with spreading roots inside a ring, a narrow golden woven border along all four edges, visible wool weave, stylized hand-painted game texture for a Nordic fairy-tale game. No folds, no shadows, no background, no pole, no text.

notice_paper.prompt: Flat texture seen straight on and filling the whole frame edge to edge: four notes of rough parchment and pale birch bark pinned overlapping on weathered wooden planks, each with a few short lines of dark ink handwriting and a small sketch (a fish, an axe, a campfire, a wolf), iron nails holding them, stylized hand-painted game texture for a Nordic fairy-tale game. No shadows, no perspective, no readable words.
